## 0 Introduction

This is the final R code that was used to obtain all the main reuslts, tables and figures for the manuscript: Sehgal et al (2025) doi: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ntt.2025.107536

## 1 Data Import

The imported exposure (that is cannabis, tobacco and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide levels) and covariate data has been recoded and cleaned as needed. The imported outcome data includes NNNS at 2 months (arousal and attention scores from pca) and CBCL measured anuually during pre-school (ages 1-5; internalization and externalization).

## 2 Sociodemographics

**Table 1.** Description of socio-demographic and health characteristics of the mother-child pairs in Atlanta, Georgia (2014–2022).

```{r nnns_demographics_table1, echo=FALSE}
## add Table 1 - NNNS
table1.cont <- function(x) {
  with(stats.apply.rounding(stats.default(x), digits=2), c("",
                                                           "Mean (SD)"=sprintf("%s (%s)", MEAN, SD)))
}
tabe1.cat <- function(x) {
  c("", sapply(stats.default(x), function(y) with(y,
                                                  sprintf("%d (%0.0f %%)", FREQ, PCT))))
}
table2.quartiles <- function(x, name, data2, ...) {
  Q05 <- quantile(x, 0.05, na.rm = T)
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = T)
  median <- median(x, na.rm = T)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = T)
  Q95 <- quantile(x, 0.95, na.rm = T)
  
  out <- c("",
           "5%" = sprintf("%.2f", Q05),
           "25%" = sprintf("%.2f", Q1), 
           "50%" = sprintf("%.2f", median), 
           "75%" = sprintf("%.2f", Q3), 
           "95%" = sprintf("%.2f", Q95))
  out
}
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    # For numeric variables, perform a standard 2-sample t-test
    p <- t.test(y ~ g)$p.value
  } else {
    # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence
    p <- chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value
  }
  # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
  # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable label.
  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}
```

## 3 Cannabis, Tobacco, and Insecticides Biomarkers in maternal urine

**Table 2.** Distribution of maternal urinary cannabis, tobacco, pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) during pregnancy among pregnant women who were exposed to cannabis or not in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022). 

```{r combined_sample_table2}
list_exposures1<- c("3OH-COT", "3OH-COT_CC", "3OH-COTraw", # smoking biomakers
                    "COT", "COT_CC", "COTraw",
                    "THCA" , # THC_CC #Marijuana biomarker, 
                    "TCPY", "TCPY_CC", # Organophosphates
                    # "t-DCCA","t-DCCA_CC", # Pyrethroid insecticides
                    "3-PBA", "3-PBA_CC", 
                    # "c-DCCA", "c-DCCA_CC",
                    "Creat" ) 

combined_sampled<- rbind.data.frame(complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all %>%  select(ptid,THC_CC, list_exposures1, MarijuanaUse_MRorSR, THC_binary),
                                    complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all %>%  select(ptid, THC_CC, list_exposures1, MarijuanaUse_MRorSR, THC_binary )) %>%  distinct(ptid, .keep_all = TRUE)

       combined_sampled,
       render.continuous=c("Geo. mean (Geo. SD)"="GMEAN (GSD)"))
```

Note: Percent (%) above the limit of detection at pregnancy average reflects the detection rates for at least one of the two-time points: early or mid-pregnancy. Bolded values are statistically significant differences in geometric mean and SD at p<0.05.

```{r cbcl_table2}
                `THC_CC` = if_else(`THC_CC` == "37", "0", `THC_CC`), 
                `3-PBA_CC` = if_else( `3-PBA_CC` == "37", "0", `3-PBA_CC`), 
                TCPY_CC = if_else(TCPY_CC == "37", "0", TCPY_CC) 
         )) 
table1(~ THCA_CC +`3OH-COT_CC` + COT_CC + THCA_CC +  `3-PBA_CC` + `TCPY_CC`, data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1 %>% distinct(ptid, .keep_all = TRUE)) 
table1(~ THCA_CC +`3OH-COT_CC` + COT_CC + THCA_CC +  `3-PBA_CC` + `TCPY_CC`, data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2 %>% distinct(ptid, .keep_all = TRUE))

```

## 5 Indivdiual effects of cannabis, tobacco and insecticides on neurobehaviors
**Unadjusted models**
*Table S2.* Individual effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary cannabis, tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) in early-pregnancy, mid-pregnancy and on average across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), estimated using unadjusted and adjusted linear regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).


**Table S3.** Individual effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary cannabis, tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) in early-pregnancy, mid-pregnancy and on average across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), overall and among female and male children, estimated using unadjusted and adjusted linear regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

Note: All adjusted models controlled for maternal urinary creatinine levels, child sex, child age, maternal age at enrollment, early pregnancy body mass index, income-to-poverty ratio, and alcohol use. Sex-specific models (labelled as “Female” or “Male” in the table below) also controlled for the same covariates other than child sex. Reference group for THCCOOH models is “non detect” and THCCOOH models show the estimated change in the child neurobehavior outcome among pregnant women who had detectable urinary THCCOOH levels compared to those who did not have detectable urinary THCCOOH levels while adjusting for covariates. Statistically significant associations (p<0.05) are bolded.

```{r nnns_overall_sex_slr}
## Models control for: lnCreat, infant Sex, infant age (as per agedays1wk_SME), maternal age, FirstPrenatalBMI, income,  AlcoholUse_MRorSR
exposure_list <- c("THC_binary", "ln3OHCOT", "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")

# run individual models for attention 
attention.list    <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znattention ~ i , 
                                                                     list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all)})
attention.list.v1 <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znattention ~ i ,
                                                                     list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1)})
attention.list.v2 <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znattention ~ i , 
                                                                     list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2)})

# run individual models for arousal
arousal.list <-    lapply(exposure_list,  function(x){lm(substitute(Znarousal ~ i , 
                                                                    list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all)})
arousal.list.v1 <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znarousal ~ i , 
                                                                   list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1)})
arousal.list.v2 <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znarousal ~ i , 
                                                                   list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2)})


tab_model(c(attention.list, attention.list.v1, attention.list.v2))
tab_model(c(arousal.list, arousal.list.v1, arousal.list.v2))
# key take way = removing insurance didnt make a difference => insurance isnt a confounder! 

outcome_list<- c("Z score Attention", "Z score Arousal")
noutcomes <- length(c("Z score Attention", "Z score Arousal"))
trimester <- c("Pregnancy Average", "Early Pregnancy", "Mid Pregnancy")
results <- rbind.data.frame(data.frame(exposure = exposure_list,
                                       outcome = rep(outcome_list,  each = length(exposure_list)), 
                                       psi = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ll = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ul = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       n = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       trimester = trimester[1], 
                                       type = "Overall, non-sex"), 
                            data.frame(exposure = exposure_list,
                                       outcome = rep(outcome_list,  each = length(exposure_list)), 
                                       psi = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ll = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ul = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       n = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       trimester = trimester[2], 
                                       type = "Overall, non-sex"), 
                            data.frame(exposure = exposure_list,
                                       outcome = rep(outcome_list,  each = length(exposure_list)), 
                                       psi = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ll = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ul = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       n = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       trimester = trimester[3], 
                                       type = "Overall, non-sex"))

lm_mat_out<- c(attention.list,  arousal.list,
               attention.list.v1, arousal.list.v1,
               attention.list.v2, arousal.list.v2) 

# save model retuls
lm.function <- function(n){ 
  # Output results from mixture
  psi<-round(lm_mat_out[[n]]$coefficients[2],4) # extract overall mixture estimate
  
  # 95%ci
  psi.ci.ll<-round(confint(lm_mat_out[[n]])[2],5)
  psi.ci.ul<-round(confint(lm_mat_out[[n]])[4],5)
  
  N <-  length(lm_mat_out[[n]]$residuals)
  
  # save in data frame
  j = as.integer(n)
  data.table::set(results, j, 3L, psi)
  data.table::set(results, j, 4L, psi.ci.ll)
  data.table::set(results, j, 5L, psi.ci.ul)
  data.table::set(results, j, 6L, N)
}

lapply( 1:30, lm.function)
slr_among_overall_non_sex <- results
write.csv(slr_among_overall_non_sex, file = "slr_among_overall_non_sex.csv")
```

**Adjusted models: overall and sex-specific**
The following code produced: 

**Figure 1.** Forest plots showing the individual effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary cannabis, tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) averaged across pregnancy on each of the zscores for attention and arousal neurobehaviors at 2 weeks (as per the NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale) and each of the natural log transformed externalizing and internalizing behaviors over the years 2 to 5 (as per the Child Behavior Checklist), overall and among female and male children, estimated using linear regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

*Table S2.* Individual effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary cannabis, tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) in early-pregnancy, mid-pregnancy and on average across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), estimated using unadjusted and adjusted linear regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

Note: All adjusted models controlled for maternal urinary creatinine levels, child sex, child age, maternal age at enrollment, early pregnancy body mass index, income-to-poverty ratio, and alcohol use. As provided in Table S2-S3, the sample size for models of NNNS outcomes overall = 110; among females = 57 and among males = 53. Sample size for models of CBCL outcomes overall = 167; among females = 81; and among males = 86

**Table S3.** Individual effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary cannabis, tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) in early-pregnancy, mid-pregnancy and on average across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), overall and among female and male children, estimated using unadjusted and adjusted linear regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

Note: All adjusted models controlled for maternal urinary creatinine levels, child sex, child age, maternal age at enrollment, early pregnancy body mass index, income-to-poverty ratio, and alcohol use. Sex-specific models (labelled as “Female” or “Male” in the table below) also controlled for the same covariates other than child sex. Reference group for THCCOOH models is “non detect” and THCCOOH models show the estimated change in the child neurobehavior outcome among pregnant women who had detectable urinary THCCOOH levels compared to those who did not have detectable urinary THCCOOH levels while adjusting for covariates. Statistically significant associations (p<0.05) are bolded.

```{r nnns_mlr}
#### NON-sex specific ####

## Models control for: lnCreat, infant Sex, infant age (as per correctedagedays1wk_SME), maternal age, FirstPrenatalBMI, income,  AlcoholUse_MRorSR
exposure_list <- c("THC_binary", "ln3OHCOT", "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")

# run individual models for attention 
attention.list    <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znattention ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR, 
                                                                     list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all)})
attention.list.v1 <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znattention ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR,
                                                                     list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1)})
attention.list.v2 <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znattention ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR, 
                                                                     list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2)})

# run individual models for arousal
arousal.list <-    lapply(exposure_list,  function(x){lm(substitute(Znarousal ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR, 
                                                                    list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all)})
arousal.list.v1 <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znarousal ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR, 
                                                                   list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1)})
arousal.list.v2 <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znarousal ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR, 
                                                                   list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2)})
# save results
outcome_list<- c("Z score Attention", "Z score Arousal")
noutcomes <- length(c("Z score Attention", "Z score Arousal"))
trimester <- c("Pregnancy Average", "Early Pregnancy", "Mid Pregnancy")
results <- rbind.data.frame(data.frame(exposure = exposure_list,
                                       outcome = rep(outcome_list,  each = length(exposure_list)), 
                                       psi = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ll = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ul = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       n = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       trimester = trimester[1], 
                                       type = "Overall, non-sex"), 
                            data.frame(exposure = exposure_list,
                                       outcome = rep(outcome_list,  each = length(exposure_list)), 
                                       psi = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ll = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ul = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       n = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       trimester = trimester[2], 
                                       type = "Overall, non-sex"), 
                            data.frame(exposure = exposure_list,
                                       outcome = rep(outcome_list,  each = length(exposure_list)), 
                                       psi = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ll = rep(0, times=noutcomes),
                                       psi.ci.ul = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       n = rep(0, times=noutcomes), 
                                       trimester = trimester[3], 
                                       type = "Overall, non-sex"))

lm_mat_out<- c(attention.list,  arousal.list,
               attention.list.v1, arousal.list.v1,
               attention.list.v2, arousal.list.v2) 

# save model retuls
lm.function <- function(n){ 
  # Output results from mixture
  psi<-round(lm_mat_out[[n]]$coefficients[2],4) # extract overall mixture estimate
  
  # 95%ci
  psi.ci.ll<-round(confint(lm_mat_out[[n]])[2],5)
  psi.ci.ul<-round(confint(lm_mat_out[[n]])[12],5)
  
  N <-  length(lm_mat_out[[n]]$residuals)
  
  # save in data frame
  j = as.integer(n)
  data.table::set(results, j, 3L, psi)
  data.table::set(results, j, 4L, psi.ci.ll)
  data.table::set(results, j, 5L, psi.ci.ul)
  data.table::set(results, j, 6L, N)
}

lapply( 1:30, lm.function)
lm_among_overall_non_sex <- results

write.csv(lm_among_overall_non_sex, file = "mlr_among_overall_non_sex.csv")
```

```{r cbcl_mlr}
                                                                          list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1 %>%  filter(Sex == "Male"))})
```

## 6 Cannabis-specific Indivdiual effects of tobacco and insecticides on neurobehaviors
The following code produced:
**Figure 2.** Forest plots showing the individual and cumulative effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) averaged across pregnancy on each of the z-scores for attention and arousal neurobehaviors at 2 weeks (as per the NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale) and each of the natural log transformed externalizing and internalizing behaviors over the years 2 to 5 (as per the Child Behavior Checklist), overall and among female and male children prenatally exposed to cannabis or not (as measured by detection of maternal urinary THCCOOH levels), estimated using linear regression and quantile gcomputation, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

**Table S4.** Differential individual effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) in early-pregnancy, mid-pregnancy and on average across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), among children prenatally exposed to cannabis or not (as measured by detection of maternal urinary THCCOOH levels), estimated using adjusted linear regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

 
**Table S5.** Differential individual effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) averaged across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), among female and male children prenatally exposed to cannabis or not (as measured by detection of maternal urinary THCCOOH levels), estimated using adjusted linear regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

```{r nnns_thc_binary_sex_overall}
arousal.list.v2.nd <- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){lm(substitute(Znarousal ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR,

lm_mat_out<- c(attention.list,  arousal.list,
                      attention.list.v1, arousal.list.v1,
                      attention.list.v2, arousal.list.v2, 
                      attention.list.nd, arousal.list.nd,
                      attention.list.v1.nd, arousal.list.v1.nd,
                      attention.list.v2.nd, arousal.list.v2.nd) 

# save model retuls
lm.function <- function(n){ 
  # Output results from mixture
  psi<-round(lm_mat_out[[n]]$coefficients[2],4) # extract overall mixture estimate
  
  # 95%ci
  psi.ci.ll<-round(confint(lm_mat_out[[n]])[2],5)
  psi.ci.ul<-round(confint(lm_mat_out[[n]])[12],5)
  
  N <-  length(lm_mat_out[[n]]$residuals)
  
  # save in data frame
  j = as.integer(n)
  data.table::set(results, j, 3L, psi)
  data.table::set(results, j, 4L, psi.ci.ll)
  data.table::set(results, j, 5L, psi.ci.ul)
  data.table::set(results, j, 6L, N)
}

lapply( 1:48, lm.function)
lm_among_thc_binary <- results
write.csv(lm_among_thc_binary, file = "lm_among_thc_binary.csv")

               attention.list.v1, arousal.list.v1,
               attention.list.v2, arousal.list.v2, 
               attention.list.nd, arousal.list.nd,
               attention.list.v1.nd, arousal.list.v1.nd,
               attention.list.v2.nd, arousal.list.v2.nd) 

# save model retuls
lm.function <- function(n){ 
  # Output results from mixture
  psi<-round(lm_mat_out[[n]]$coefficients[2],4) # extract overall mixture estimate
  
  # 95%ci
  psi.ci.ll<-round(confint(lm_mat_out[[n]])[2],5)
  psi.ci.ul<-round(confint(lm_mat_out[[n]])[12],5)
  
  N <-  length(lm_mat_out[[n]]$residuals)
  
  # save in data frame
  j = as.integer(n)
  data.table::set(results, j, 3L, psi)
  data.table::set(results, j, 4L, psi.ci.ll)
  data.table::set(results, j, 5L, psi.ci.ul)
  data.table::set(results, j, 6L, N)
}

lapply( 1:48, lm.function)
lm_among_thc_binary_m <- results
```

## 7 QGCOMP effects of cannabis, tobacco, and insecticides on NNNS
**Table S6.** Differential cumulative effect of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) in early-pregnancy, mid-pregnancy and on average across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), among children prenatally exposed to cannabis or not (as measured by detection of maternal urinary THCCOOH levels), estimated using quantile g-computation, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

**Table S7.** Differential cumulative effect of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) averaged across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), among female or male children prenatally exposed to cannabis or not (as measured by detection of maternal urinary THCCOOH levels), estimated using quantile g-computation, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).


```{r nnns_qgcomp}
### overall ####
# save exposures 
mixture <- c( "ln3OHCOT", "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY" )

# convert effect modifier variable to binary - cause qgcomp needs it that way! 
complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary <- factor(complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))
complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$THC_binary <- factor(complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))
complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$THC_binary <- factor(complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))

# save a function 
qgcomp.function.int <- function(data, i){
  if(i == "Z score Attention NNNS"){
    q_gcomp <- qgcomp.noboot(Znattention ~ lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + 
                               `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                             expnms= mixture, 
                             as.data.frame(data), , 
                             family=gaussian(), 
                             q=4)} else{
                               q_gcomp <- qgcomp.noboot(Znarousal ~ lnCreat + Sex + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + 
                                                          `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                                        expnms= mixture, 
                                                        as.data.frame(data), 
                                                        family=gaussian(), 
                                                        q=4)} 
  
  # Output results from mixture 
  psi<-round(q_gcomp$psi,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  # Output results from mixture 
  psi.ci.ll<-round(q_gcomp$ci.coef,2)[2] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul<-round(q_gcomp$ci.coef,2)[4] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights = c(q_gcomp[["pos.weights"]], -q_gcomp[["neg.weights"]])
  weights = data.frame(t(weights))
  weights <- weights[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  
  qgcomp_summary_comp<- cbind(psi, psi.ci.ll, psi.ci.ul, weights,  i) #combine
}

qgcomp_tob_insect_only_non_sex_specific <- 
  rbind( qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, i = "Z score Attention NNNS"), # overall/pregnancy average
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, i = "Z score Arousal NNNS"), 
         
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1, i = "Z score Attention NNNS"), # trimester 1/ early pregnancy
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1, i = "Z score Arousal NNNS"),
         
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2, i = "Z score Attention NNNS"),  # trimester 2/ mid pregnancy
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2, i = "Z score Arousal NNNS"))

qgcomp_tob_insect_only_non_sex_specific$visit <- rep(c("Pregnancy Average", "Early Pregnancy", "Mid-Pregnancy"), each = 2)
colnames(qgcomp_tob_insect_only_non_sex_specific) <- c("psi", "lcl", "ucl",  "ln3OHCOT", "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY", "outcome", "visit")

write.csv(qgcomp_tob_insect_only_non_sex_specific, file = "qgcomp_tob_insect_nonsex_specific.csv")
```

```{r nnns_qgcomp_sex}
##### overall, sex specific ####
# save exposures 
mixture <- c( "ln3OHCOT", "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY" )

# convert effect modifier variable to binary - cause qgcomp needs it that way! 
complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$Sex <- factor(complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$Sex <- factor(complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$Sex <- factor(complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))

# save a function 
qgcomp.function.int <- function(data, i){
  if(i == "Z score Attention NNNS"){
    q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(Znattention ~ lnCreat + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + 
                                   `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                 expnms= mixture, 
                                 emmvar = "Sex", 
                                 as.data.frame(data), 
                                 family=gaussian(), 
                                 q=4)} else{
                                   q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(Znarousal ~ lnCreat + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + 
                                                                  `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                                                expnms= mixture, 
                                                                emmvar = "Sex", 
                                                                as.data.frame(data), 
                                                                family=gaussian(), 
                                                                q=4)} 
  
  # Output results from mixture 
  gcomp<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Male")
  psi_detect<-round(gcomp$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_detect<-round(gcomp$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_detect<-round(gcomp$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp,emmval="Male")
  weights = c(weights[["pos.weights"]], -weights[["neg.weights"]])
  weights = data.frame(t(weights))
  weights <- weights[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  # Output results from mixture , females
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Female")
  psi_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_nd =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp,emmval="Female")
  weights_nd = c(weights_nd[["pos.weights"]], -weights_nd[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_nd = data.frame(t(weights_nd))
  weights_nd <- weights_nd[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  qgcomp_summary_comp<- cbind(psi_detect,psi.ci.ll_detect, psi.ci.ul_detect, weights, 
                              psi_nondetect, psi.ci.ll_nondetect, psi.ci.ul_nondetect, weights_nd, 
                              i) #combine
}

qgcomp_tob_insect_only_sex_specific <- 
  rbind( qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, i = "Z score Attention NNNS"), # overall/pregnancy average
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, i = "Z score Arousal NNNS"), 
         
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1, i = "Z score Attention NNNS"), # trimester 1/ early pregnancy

         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2, i = "Z score Arousal NNNS"))
```

```{r nnns_cb_qgcomp}
                                   `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,

                                 as.data.frame(data),
```

```{r nnns_cb_qgcomp_sex}
                                   q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(Znarousal ~ lnCreat + correctedagedays1wk_SME + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + 
                                                                  `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,

  # Output results from mixture
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Detect_Male")
  psi_detect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_detect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture

  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)

  # Output results from mixture
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Non-Detect_Female")
  psi_nondetect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_nondetect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_nondetect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_nd_f =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp, emmval = "Non-Detect_Female")
  weights_nd_f = c(weights_nd_f[["pos.weights"]], -weights_nd_f[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_nd_f = data.frame(t(weights_nd_f))
  weights_nd_f <- weights_nd_f[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  
  
  
  # Output results from mixture
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Non-Detect_Male")
  psi_nondetect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_nondetect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_nondetect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_nd_m =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp,emmval="Non-Detect_Male")
  weights_nd_m = c(weights_nd_m[["pos.weights"]], -weights_nd_m[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_nd_m = data.frame(t(weights_nd_m))
  weights_nd_m <- weights_nd_m[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  qgcomp_summary_comp<- cbind(psi_detect_m,psi.ci.ll_detect_m, psi.ci.ul_detect_m, weights_d_m, 
                              psi_detect_f,psi.ci.ll_detect_f, psi.ci.ul_detect_f, weights_d_f, 
                              
                              psi_nondetect_m, psi.ci.ll_nondetect_m, psi.ci.ul_nondetect_m, weights_nd_m, 
                              psi_nondetect_f, psi.ci.ll_nondetect_f, psi.ci.ul_nondetect_f, weights_nd_f, 
                              
                              i) #combine
}
```

## 8  QGCOMP effects of cannabis, tobacco, and insecticides on CBCL
**Table S6.** Differential cumulative effect of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) in early-pregnancy, mid-pregnancy and on average across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), among children prenatally exposed to cannabis or not (as measured by detection of maternal urinary THCCOOH levels), estimated using quantile g-computation, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

```{r cbcl_qgcomp}
#### overall #### 
mixture <- c( "ln3OHCOT", "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY" )

# convert effect modifier variable to binary - cause qgcomp needs it that way! 
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$THC_binary <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$THC_binary <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))

# save a function 
qgcomp.function.int <- function(data, i){
  if(i == "Internalizing"){
    q_gcomp <- qgcomp.noboot(CBCLinternalizing_name ~ lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  + 
                                   `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                 expnms= mixture, 
                                 as.data.frame(data), 
                                 family=gaussian(), 
                                 q=4)} else{
                                   q_gcomp <- qgcomp.noboot(CBCLexternalizing_name ~ lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  + 
                                                                  `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                                                expnms= mixture, 
                                                                as.data.frame(data), 
                                                                family=gaussian(), 
                                                                q=4)} 
  
  # Output results from mixture 
  psi<-round(q_gcomp$psi,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  # Output results from mixture 
  psi.ci.ll<-round(q_gcomp$ci.coef,2)[2] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul<-round(q_gcomp$ci.coef,2)[4] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights = c(q_gcomp[["pos.weights"]], -q_gcomp[["neg.weights"]])
  weights = data.frame(t(weights))
  weights <- weights[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  qgcomp_summary_comp<- cbind(psi, psi.ci.ll, psi.ci.ul, weights,  i) #combine
}

qgcomp_tob_insect_only_non_sex_specific <- 
  rbind( qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, i = "Internalizing"), # overall/pregnancy average
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, i = "Externalizing"), 
         
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1, i = "Internalizing"), # trimester 1/ early pregnancy
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1, i = "Externalizing"),
         
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2, i = "Internalizing"),  # trimester 2/ mid pregnancy
         qgcomp.function.int(data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2, i = "Externalizing"))

qgcomp_tob_insect_only_non_sex_specific$visit <- rep(c("Pregnancy Average", "Early Pregnancy", "Mid-Pregnancy"), each = 2)

write.csv(qgcomp_tob_insect_only_non_sex_specific, file = "qgcomp_tob_insect_nonsex_specific.csv")
```

```{r cbcl_cb_qgcomp}
##### cannabis specific ########
# save exposures 
mixture <- c( "ln3OHCOT", "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY" )

# convert effect modifier variable to binary - cause qgcomp needs it that way! 
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$THC_binary <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$THC_binary <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$THC_binary, levels = c("Detect", "Non-Detect"))

# save a function 
qgcomp.function.int <- function(data, i){
  if(i == "Internalizing"){
    q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(CBCLinternalizing_name ~ lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  + 
                                   `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                 expnms= mixture, 
                                 emmvar = "THC_binary", 
                                 as.data.frame(data), 
                                 family=gaussian(), 
                                 q=4)} else{
                                   q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(CBCLexternalizing_name ~ lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  + 
                                                                  `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                                                expnms= mixture, 
                                                                emmvar = "THC_binary", 
                                                                as.data.frame(data), 
                                                                family=gaussian(), 
                                                                q=4)} 
  
  # Output results from mixture 
  psi_detect<-round(q_gcomp$psi,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_detect<-round(q_gcomp$ci.coef,2)[2] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_detect<-round(q_gcomp$ci.coef,2)[6] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights = c(q_gcomp[["pos.weights"]], -q_gcomp[["neg.weights"]])
  weights = data.frame(t(weights))
  weights <- weights[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  # Output results from mixture , females
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Non-Detect")
  psi_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_nd =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp,emmval="Non-Detect")
  weights_nd = c(weights_nd[["pos.weights"]], -weights_nd[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_nd = data.frame(t(weights_nd))
  weights_nd <- weights_nd[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  qgcomp_summary_comp<- cbind(psi_detect,psi.ci.ll_detect, psi.ci.ul_detect, weights, 
                              psi_nondetect, psi.ci.ll_nondetect, psi.ci.ul_nondetect, weights_nd, 
                              i) #combine
}

qgcomp_summary_non_sex_specific <-
```

```{r cbcl_qgcomp_sex}
##### overall, sex specific ####
# save exposures 
mixture <- c( "ln3OHCOT", "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY" )

# convert effect modifier variable to binary - cause qgcomp needs it that way! 
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$Sex <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$Sex <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$Sex <- factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))

# save a function 
qgcomp.function.int <- function(data, i){
  if(i == "Internalizing"){
    q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(CBCLinternalizing_name ~ lnCreat  + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  + 
                                   `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                 expnms= mixture, 
                                 emmvar = "Sex", 
                                 as.data.frame(data), 
                                 family=gaussian(), 
                                 q=4)} else{
                                   q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(CBCLexternalizing_name ~ lnCreat + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  + 
                                                                  `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                                                expnms= mixture, 
                                                                emmvar = "Sex", 
                                                                as.data.frame(data), 
                                                                family=gaussian(), 
                                                                q=4)} 
  
  # Output results from mixture 
  gcomp<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Male")
  psi_detect<-round(gcomp$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_detect<-round(gcomp$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_detect<-round(gcomp$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp,emmval="Male")
  weights = c(weights[["pos.weights"]], -weights[["neg.weights"]])
  weights = data.frame(t(weights))
  weights <- weights[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  # Output results from mixture , females
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Female")
  psi_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_nondetect<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_nd =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp,emmval="Female")
  weights_nd = c(weights_nd[["pos.weights"]], -weights_nd[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_nd = data.frame(t(weights_nd))
  weights_nd <- weights_nd[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  qgcomp_summary_comp<- cbind(psi_detect,psi.ci.ll_detect, psi.ci.ul_detect, weights, 
                              psi_nondetect, psi.ci.ll_nondetect, psi.ci.ul_nondetect, weights_nd, 
                              i) #combine
}
```

```{r cbcl_cb_qgcomp_sex}
#### cannabis, sex specific ####
# define effect modifier that takes into account THC_binary and infant_sex info 
# create combined variable for detect/nondetect from THC_binary and male/female from infant sex 
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all <- complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all %>%  mutate(THC_binary_sex = paste0(THC_binary, "_", Sex))

complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2 <- complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2 %>%  mutate(THC_binary_sex = paste0(THC_binary, "_", Sex))

class(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary_sex)

complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary_sex <- as.factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all$THC_binary_sex)
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$THC_binary_sex <- as.factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1$THC_binary_sex)
complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$THC_binary_sex <- as.factor(complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2$THC_binary_sex)

# save a function 
qgcomp.function.int.sex <- function(data, i){
  if(i == "Internalizing"){
    q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(CBCLinternalizing_name ~ lnCreat  + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  + 
                                   `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                 expnms= mixture, 
                                 emmvar = "THC_binary_sex", 
                                 as.data.frame(data), 
                                 family=gaussian(), 
                                 q=4)} else{
                                   q_gcomp <- qgcomp.emm.noboot(CBCLexternalizing_name ~ lnCreat  + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  + 
                                                                  `ln3OHCOT` + `lnCOT` + `ln3PBA` + `lnTCPY`,  
                                                                expnms= mixture, 
                                                                emmvar = "THC_binary_sex", 
                                                                as.data.frame(data), 
                                                                family=gaussian(), 
                                                                q=4)} 
  
  # Output results from mixture
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Detect_Male")
  psi_detect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_detect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_detect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_d_m =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp,emmval="Detect_Male")
  weights_d_m = c(weights_d_m[["pos.weights"]], -weights_d_m[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_d_m = data.frame(t(weights_d_m))
  weights_d_m <- weights_d_m[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  
  
  # Output results from mixture
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Detect_Female")
  psi_detect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_detect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_detect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_d_f =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp, emmval = "Detect_Female")
  weights_d_f = c(weights_d_f[["pos.weights"]], -weights_d_f[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_d_f = data.frame(t(weights_d_f))
  weights_d_f <- weights_d_f[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  
  
  # Output results from mixture
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Non-Detect_Female")
  psi_nondetect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_nondetect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_nondetect_f<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_nd_f =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp, emmval = "Non-Detect_Female")
  weights_nd_f = c(weights_nd_f[["pos.weights"]], -weights_nd_f[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_nd_f = data.frame(t(weights_nd_f))
  weights_nd_f <- weights_nd_f[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  
  # Output results from mixture
  qgcomp_int<- qgcompint::getstrateffects(q_gcomp, emmval = "Non-Detect_Male")
  psi_nondetect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$eff,2) # extract overall mixture estimate
  psi.ci.ll_nondetect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,1] #extract CI for mixture
  psi.ci.ul_nondetect_m<-round(qgcomp_int$ci,2)[,2] #extract CI for mixture
  # figure 1.  heatmap for plot(qgcomp)
  # use weights from
  weights_nd_m =  qgcompint::getstratweights(q_gcomp,emmval="Non-Detect_Male")
  weights_nd_m = c(weights_nd_m[["pos.weights"]], -weights_nd_m[["neg.weights"]])
  weights_nd_m = data.frame(t(weights_nd_m))
  weights_nd_m <- weights_nd_m[, c(  "ln3OHCOT",  "lnCOT", "ln3PBA", "lnTCPY")]
  
  qgcomp_summary_comp<- cbind(psi_detect_m,psi.ci.ll_detect_m, psi.ci.ul_detect_m, weights_d_m, 
                              psi_detect_f,psi.ci.ll_detect_f, psi.ci.ul_detect_f, weights_d_f, 
                              
                              psi_nondetect_m, psi.ci.ll_nondetect_m, psi.ci.ul_nondetect_m, weights_nd_m, 
                              psi_nondetect_f, psi.ci.ll_nondetect_f, psi.ci.ul_nondetect_f, weights_nd_f, 
                              
                              i) #combine
}
```

### 8.1 Forest plot
**Figure 1.** Forest plots showing the individual effects of natural log-transformed maternal urinary cannabis, tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) averaged across pregnancy on each of the z-scores for attention and arousal neurobehaviors at 2 weeks (as per the NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale) and each of the natural log transformed externalizing and internalizing behaviors over the years 2 to 5 (as per the Child Behavior Checklist), overall and among female and male children, estimated using linear regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014–2022).

```{r forest_plot}
# step 1. load cleaned results from above
# step 2. plot
ggplot(rbind.data.frame(forest_results_overallTHC_emmTHC,lm_meanCBCL_Y1Y5)   %>% filter(trimester == "Pregnancy Average",  type == "Overall"),
                   aes(x = psi, xmin = psi.ci.ll, xmax = psi.ci.ul,
                       y = factor(exposure, levels = c("lnTCPY", "ln3PBA","lnCOT","ln3OHCOT", "THC","Mixture")),
                       color = interaction(Sex, outcome))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash", position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.2, lwd = 1.05, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, shape = "circle", stroke = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  xlab("Effect Estimate (95% CI)") +
  ylab(" ") +
  labs(color = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c( rep( rev(microshades::microshades_palette("micro_purple"))[2], 3), 
                                 rep(microshades::microshades_palette("micro_blue")[4], 3), 
                                 "#b07aa1", "#b07aa1","#b07aa1",
                                 "#b6992d","#b6992d", "#b6992d"
                                )) +
  facet_grid(factor(Sex, levels = c("Overall","Female", "Male") )
             ~ factor(outcome, levels = c("z-score Arousal NNNS", "z-score Attention NNNS", "lnCBCL Externalizing", "lnCBCL Internalizing")), 
             scales = "free", labeller = labeller(outcome = label_wrap_gen(width =25))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", colour = "black"))
```

### 8.2 Heatmaps for qgcomp weights 
**Figure S5.** Heatmap showing the positive and negative weight of each partial effect of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), among children prenatally exposed to cannabis (A) or not (B) in early-pregnancy, mid-pregnancy and on average across pregnancy (as measured by detection of maternal urinary THCCOOH levels),  estimated using quantile g-computation, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

**Figure S6.** Heatmap showing the positive and negative weight of each partial effect of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, and pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist), overall and among female and male children prenatally exposed to cannabis (A) or not (B) averaged across pregnancy (as measured by detection of maternal urinary THCCOOH levels), estimated using quantile g-computation, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022).

Note: All adjusted models controlled for maternal urinary creatinine levels, child sex, child age, maternal age at enrollment, early pregnancy body mass index, income-to-poverty ratio, and alcohol use. Sex-specific models (labelled as “Females” or “Males” below) also controlled for the same covariates other than child sex. In each model (shown as a row), all positive weights (shown in brown hues) sum to 1 and all negative weights (shown in purple hues) sum to 1. The negative and positive weights should not be compared to each other however, all positive (or negative) weights are comparable amongst themselves.

### 8.3 Math for interpretable coefficients
```{r convert_beta}
# input cbcl or nnns for whichever estimate you'd like to convert
out <- "nnns"
# input raw estiamtes as needed
beta <- 0.17
  lcl <-  0
  ucl <- 0.33
  
# run an if else statement
if(out == "nnns"){paste0("beta = ", round( (beta* log(2) * 100), 2), 
                        "; 95%CI = (", round( (lcl * log(2) * 100), 2), 
                        ", ", round( (ucl * log(2) * 100), 2), ")" ) }else{paste0("beta = ", round( ((2^beta) - 1) *100, 2), 
                                                               "; 95%CI = (", round( ((2^lcl) - 1) *100, 2), 
                                                               ", ", round( ((2^ucl) - 1) *100, 2), ")" )}
                    
```

## 9 BKMR 

**Figure S7.**Cumulative effects (A) and univariate exposure–response functions and its 95% credible intervals, while holding all the remaining exposures in the mixture fixed at their median concentration (B), for the effect of natural log-transformed maternal urinary tobacco, pyrethroid and organophosphate insecticide metabolite levels (ng/mL) averaged across pregnancy on child neurobehaviors (as per NICU Network Neurobehavioral Assessment Scale and Child Behavior Checklist) estimated using Bayesian kernel machine regression, in an Atlanta Maternal-Child cohort (2014-2022). 
Note: All adjusted models controlled for maternal urinary creatinine levels, child sex, child age, maternal age at enrollment, early pregnancy body mass index, income-to-poverty ratio, and alcohol use. Sample size for NNNS models = 110 whereas sample size for CBCL models = 167.


```{r bkmr_nnns}
# Fig S7: create a global function for bkmr among overall sample (forget thc binary)
bkmr_function_tob_pest<- function(d, outcome){
  
  d <- as.data.frame(d) 
  
  # arousal
  bkmr_data<- d %>%  select(lnCreat, Sex, correctedagedays1wk_SME, age_enrollment, FirstPrenatalBMI, income, AlcoholUse_MRorSR, 
                            # THC_binary,
                            `ln3OHCOT`, `lnCOT`,  `ln3PBA`, `lnTCPY`, 
                            as.name(outcome)) 
  ## create exposure df
  bkmr_exp<- bkmr_data %>% select(c(`ln3OHCOT`, `lnCOT`,  `ln3PBA`, `lnTCPY`))
  
  ## recode so that BKMR can run using numeric vars    
  bkmr_covar<- bkmr_data %>%  select(c(lnCreat, Sex, correctedagedays1wk_SME, age_enrollment, FirstPrenatalBMI, income, AlcoholUse_MRorSR)) %>%  
    mutate(AlcoholUse_MRorSR  = ifelse(AlcoholUse_MRorSR  == "Yes", 1, 0),
           income = as.factor(case_when(income == "less than 100%" ~ 0, 
                                        income == "100-149%" ~ 1, 
                                        income == "150% or more" ~ 2 )),
           Sex = ifelse(Sex == "Female", 1, 0)) %>%  mutate_all(as.numeric)
  
  
  # run bkmr
  set.seed(111)
  bkmr <- kmbayes(y = as.numeric(unlist(bkmr_data[,12])),
                  Z = bkmr_exp,
                  X = bkmr_covar,
                  iter = 10000, verbose = FALSE, varsel = TRUE,
                  family='gaussian')
  
  # ## BKMR univariate plot: Create univariate exposure-response function
  pred.resp.univar <- PredictorResponseUnivar(fit = bkmr)
  print(ggplot(pred.resp.univar,
               aes(x=z, y=est, color=variable, group=variable,
                   ymin = est - 1.96*se, ymax = est + 1.96*se)) +
          geom_smooth(stat = "identity") +
          facet_wrap(~ variable, nrow=2) +
          ylab(paste0("Difference in ", outcome))+
          xlab("Mixture Component")+
          #scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-6, -3, 0, 3, 6), limits = c(-6, 6)) +
          #scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(-1, 1)) +
          ggtitle(paste0("C. Univariate Relationship for Predictor-Response ", outcome)) +
          theme_bw())
  
  
  ##Overall effect of BKMR on to compare the 50th with the 75th percentile of all exposures
  risk <- OverallRiskSummaries(fit = bkmr,
                               y = bkmr_data[,12],
                               Z = bkmr_exp,
                               X = as.matrix(bkmr_covar),
                               qs = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.05), 
                               q.fixed = 0.5, method = "exact")
  
  risk_overall = risk 
  
  print(ggplot(risk_overall, aes(quantile, est, ymin = est - 1.96*sd, ymax = est + 1.96*sd, color = "#b07aa1", fill = "#b07aa1")) + 
          geom_pointrange(lwd= 1, fatten = 4, position=position_dodge2(width = 0.003, padding = 0.5))+
          scale_color_manual(values = c( "#b07aa1")) +   # arousal : #"#b07aa1", "#d4a6c8" # attn: "#b6992d", "#f1ce63", "darkgoldenrod4"
          ylab("Difference")+
        # facet_wrap(~type)+
          # ylim(-0.6, 0.6)+
          xlab("Percentile of Mixture Quantile")+
          theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
          geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed")+
          theme(panel.border = element_blank(),  legend.position="none",
                axis.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", colour = "black"),
                axis.text = element_text(size=11, colour = "black")) 
  )
  
}

# run bkmr
bkmr_function_tob_pest(d = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, outcome = "Znarousal")
bkmr_function_tob_pest(d = complete.nnns.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, outcome = "Znattention")
```

```{r bkmr_thc_binary}
# create a global function for bkmr among detect, among non-detect (thc_binary strata)
bkmr_function<- function(d, outcome){
  
  d <- as.data.frame(d) 
  
  # arousal
  bkmr_data<- d %>%  select(lnCreat, Sex, correctedagedays1wk_SME, age_enrollment, FirstPrenatalBMI, income, AlcoholUse_MRorSR, 
                            THC_binary,
                            `ln3OHCOT`, `lnCOT`,  `ln3PBA`, `lnTCPY`, 
                            as.name(outcome)) %>%  
    filter(THC_binary == "Detect")
  
  ## create exposure df
  bkmr_exp<- bkmr_data %>% select(c(`ln3OHCOT`, `lnCOT`,  `ln3PBA`, `lnTCPY`))
  
  ## recode so that BKMR can run using numeric vars    
  bkmr_covar<- bkmr_data %>%  select(c(lnCreat, Sex, correctedagedays1wk_SME, age_enrollment, FirstPrenatalBMI, income, AlcoholUse_MRorSR)) %>%  
    mutate(AlcoholUse_MRorSR  = ifelse(AlcoholUse_MRorSR  == "Yes", 1, 0),
           income = as.factor(case_when(income == "less than 100%" ~ 0, 
                                        income == "100-149%" ~ 1, 
                                        income == "150% or more" ~ 2 )),
           Sex = ifelse(Sex == "Female", 1, 0)) %>%  mutate_all(as.numeric)
  
  
  # arousal - non-detects
  bkmr_data2<- d %>%  select(lnCreat, Sex, correctedagedays1wk_SME, age_enrollment, FirstPrenatalBMI, income, AlcoholUse_MRorSR, 
                             THC_binary,
                             `ln3OHCOT`, `lnCOT`,  `ln3PBA`, `lnTCPY`, 
                             as.name(outcome)) %>%  
    filter(THC_binary == "Non-Detect")
  
  ## create exposure df
  bkmr_exp2<- bkmr_data2 %>% select(c(`ln3OHCOT`, `lnCOT`,  `ln3PBA`, `lnTCPY`))
  
  ## recode so that BKMR can run using numeric vars    
  bkmr_covar2<- bkmr_data2 %>%  select(c(lnCreat, Sex, correctedagedays1wk_SME, age_enrollment, FirstPrenatalBMI, income, AlcoholUse_MRorSR)) %>%  
    mutate(AlcoholUse_MRorSR  = ifelse(AlcoholUse_MRorSR  == "Yes", 1, 0),
           income = as.factor(case_when(income == "less than 100%" ~ 0, 
                                        income == "100-149%" ~ 1, 
                                        income == "150% or more" ~ 2 )),
           Sex = ifelse(Sex == "Female", 1, 0)) %>%  mutate_all(as.numeric)
  
  # run bkmr
  set.seed(111)
  bkmr <- kmbayes(y = as.numeric(unlist(bkmr_data[,13])),
                  Z = bkmr_exp,
                  X = bkmr_covar,
                  iter = 10000, verbose = FALSE, varsel = TRUE,
                  family='gaussian')
  set.seed(111)
  bkmr2 <- kmbayes(y = as.numeric(unlist(bkmr_data2[,13])),
                   Z = bkmr_exp2,
                   X = bkmr_covar2,
                   iter = 10000, verbose = FALSE, varsel = TRUE,
                   family='gaussian')
  
  # ## BKMR univariate plot: Create univariate exposure-response function
  pred.resp.univar <- PredictorResponseUnivar(fit = bkmr)
  print(ggplot(pred.resp.univar,
               aes(x=z, y=est, color=variable, group=variable,
                   ymin = est - 1.96*se, ymax = est + 1.96*se)) +
          geom_smooth(stat = "identity") +
          facet_wrap(~ variable, nrow=2) +
          ylab(paste0("Difference in ", outcome))+
          xlab("Mixture Component")+
          #scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-6, -3, 0, 3, 6), limits = c(-6, 6)) +
          #scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(-1, 1)) +
          ggtitle(paste0("C. Univariate Relationship for Predictor-Response ", outcome)) +
          theme_bw())
  
  pred.resp.univar2 <- PredictorResponseUnivar(fit = bkmr2)
  print(ggplot(pred.resp.univar2,
               aes(x=z, y=est, color=variable, group=variable,
                   ymin = est - 1.96*se, ymax = est + 1.96*se)) +
          geom_smooth(stat = "identity") +
          facet_wrap(~ variable, nrow=2) +
          ylab(paste0("Difference in ", outcome))+
          xlab("Mixture Component")+
          #scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-6, -3, 0, 3, 6), limits = c(-6, 6)) +
          #scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(-1, 1)) +
          ggtitle(paste0("C. Univariate Relationship for Predictor-Response ", outcome)) +
          theme_bw())
  
  
  ##Overall effect of BKMR on to compare the 50th with the 75th percentile of all exposures
  risk <- OverallRiskSummaries(fit = bkmr,
                               y = bkmr_data[,13],
                               Z = bkmr_exp,
                               X = as.matrix(bkmr_covar),
                               qs = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.05), 
                               q.fixed = 0.5, method = "exact")
  
  risk2 <- OverallRiskSummaries(fit = bkmr2,
                                y = bkmr_data2[,13],
                                Z = bkmr_exp2,
                                X = as.matrix(bkmr_covar2),
                                qs = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.05), 
                                q.fixed = 0.5, method = "exact")
  
  risk_overall = rbind(risk, risk2)
  risk_overall$type = c(rep("Detectable THC Levels", 11), 
                        rep("Non-Detectable THC Levels", 11))
  
  print(ggplot(risk_overall, aes(quantile, est, ymin = est - 1.96*sd, ymax = est + 1.96*sd, color = type)) + 
          geom_pointrange(lwd= 1, fatten = 4, position=position_dodge2(width = 0.003, padding = 0.5))+
          scale_color_manual(values = c( "#b07aa1", "#d4a6c8")) +   # arousal : #"#b07aa1", "#d4a6c8" # attn: "#b6992d", "#f1ce63"
          ylab("Difference")+
          facet_wrap(~type)+
          # ylim(-0.6, 0.6)+
          xlab("Percentile of Mixture Quantile")+
          theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
          geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed")+
          theme(panel.border = element_blank(),  legend.position="none",
                axis.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", colour = "black"),
                axis.text = element_text(size=11, colour = "black")) 
  )
  
}

  bkmr2 <- kmbayes(y = as.numeric(unlist(bkmr_data2[,13])),
                   Z = bkmr_exp2,
                   X = bkmr_covar2,
                   iter = 10000, verbose = FALSE, varsel = TRUE,
                   family='gaussian')
  
  # ## BKMR univariate plot: Create univariate exposure-response function
  pred.resp.univar <- PredictorResponseUnivar(fit = bkmr)
  print(ggplot(pred.resp.univar,
               aes(x=z, y=est, color=variable, group=variable,
                   ymin = est - 1.96*se, ymax = est + 1.96*se)) +
          geom_smooth(stat = "identity") +
          facet_wrap(~ variable, nrow=2) +
          ylab(paste0("Difference in ", outcome))+
          xlab("Mixture Component")+
          #scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-6, -3, 0, 3, 6), limits = c(-6, 6)) +
          #scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(-1, 1)) +
          ggtitle(paste0("C. Univariate Relationship for Predictor-Response ", outcome)) +
          theme_bw())
  
  pred.resp.univar2 <- PredictorResponseUnivar(fit = bkmr2)
  print(ggplot(pred.resp.univar2,
               aes(x=z, y=est, color=variable, group=variable,
                   ymin = est - 1.96*se, ymax = est + 1.96*se)) +
          geom_smooth(stat = "identity") +
          facet_wrap(~ variable, nrow=2) +
          ylab(paste0("Difference in ", outcome))+
          xlab("Mixture Component")+
          #scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-6, -3, 0, 3, 6), limits = c(-6, 6)) +
          #scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(-1, 1)) +
          ggtitle(paste0("C. Univariate Relationship for Predictor-Response ", outcome)) +
          theme_bw())
  
  
  ##Overall effect of BKMR on to compare the 50th with the 75th percentile of all exposures
  risk <- OverallRiskSummaries(fit = bkmr,
                               y = bkmr_data[,13],
                               Z = bkmr_exp,
                               X = as.matrix(bkmr_covar),
                               qs = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.05), 
                               q.fixed = 0.5, method = "exact")
  
  risk2 <- OverallRiskSummaries(fit = bkmr2,
                                y = bkmr_data2[,13],
                                Z = bkmr_exp2,
                                X = as.matrix(bkmr_covar2),
                                qs = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.05), 
                                q.fixed = 0.5, method = "exact")
  
  risk_overall = rbind(risk, risk2)
  risk_overall$type = c(rep("Detectable THC Levels", 11), 
                        rep("Non-Detectable THC Levels", 11))
  
  print(ggplot(risk_overall, aes(quantile, est, ymin = est - 1.96*sd, ymax = est + 1.96*sd, color = type)) + 
          geom_pointrange(lwd= 1, fatten = 4, position=position_dodge2(width = 0.003, padding = 0.5))+
          scale_color_manual(values = microshades::microshades_palette("micro_blue")[c(4, 3)]) +   # external : rev(microshades::microshades_palette("micro_purple"))[2, 3]
                                                                     #internal: microshades::microshades_palette("micro_blue")[c(4, 3)]
          ylab("Difference")+
          facet_wrap(~type)+
          # ylim(-0.6, 0.6)+
          xlab("Percentile of Mixture Quantile")+
          theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
          geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed")+
          theme(panel.border = element_blank(),  legend.position="none",
                axis.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", colour = "black"),
                axis.text = element_text(size=11, colour = "black")) 
  )
  
}
# Run BKMR among THC detects and non-detects separately for each outcome and each visit
bkmr_function(d = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, outcome = "CBCLexternalizing_name")
bkmr_function(d = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all, outcome = "CBCLinternalizing_name")
```

```{r cbcl_sens}
                                                                        list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all)})
adj.externalizing.v1<- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){  lm(substitute(  CBCLexternalizing_name ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income  + cbcl_ageinmos  ,
                                                                           list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1)})
adj.externalizing.v2<- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){  lm(substitute(  CBCLexternalizing_name ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income  + cbcl_ageinmos  ,

estimates <- lapply(c(adj.internalizing, adj.externalizing, 
                      adj.internalizing.v1, adj.externalizing.v1, 
                      adj.internalizing.v2, adj.externalizing.v2), function(model) {
  cbind.data.frame(tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE), nobs(model))}) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "model") %>%
  filter(term %in% exposure_list | term == "THC_binaryDetect") %>%  
  mutate(outcome = rep(rep(c("Internalizing", "Externalizing"), each = 5), 3), sex = "Overall") %>%  #mutate_at(.vars = 4:8, ~round(.,2)) %>%  
  mutate(trimester = rep(rep(c("Overall", "Early Pregnancy", "Mid Pregnancy"), each = 10), 1), 
         ci = paste0(round(estimate, 2), " (", floor(conf.low * 100) / 100, ", ", ceiling(conf.high * 100) / 100, ")"))

                                                                           list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1)})
adj.internalizing.v2<- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){  lm(substitute(  CBCLinternalizing_name ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income  + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  +Site_Prenatal,
                                                                           list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2)})

adj.externalizing<- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){  lm(substitute(  CBCLexternalizing_name ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income  + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  +Site_Prenatal,
                                                                        list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.all)})
adj.externalizing.v1<- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){  lm(substitute(  CBCLexternalizing_name ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income  + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos +Site_Prenatal  ,
                                                                           list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v1)})
adj.externalizing.v2<- lapply(exposure_list, function(x){  lm(substitute(  CBCLexternalizing_name ~ i + lnCreat + Sex + age_enrollment  + FirstPrenatalBMI + income  + AlcoholUse_MRorSR + cbcl_ageinmos  +Site_Prenatal,
                                                                           list(i = as.name(x))), data = complete.cbcl.cb.tob.pest.covars.v2)})

# save results
estimates <- lapply(c(adj.internalizing, adj.externalizing, 
                      adj.internalizing.v1, adj.externalizing.v1, 
                      adj.internalizing.v2, adj.externalizing.v2), function(model) {
                        cbind.data.frame(tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE), nobs(model))}) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "model") %>%
  filter(term %in% exposure_list | term == "THC_binaryDetect") %>%  
  mutate(outcome = rep(rep(c("Internalizing", "Externalizing"), each = 5), 3), sex = "Overall") %>%  #mutate_at(.vars = 4:8, ~round(.,2)) %>%  
  mutate(trimester = rep(rep(c("Overall", "Early Pregnancy", "Mid Pregnancy"), each = 10), 1), 
         ci = paste0(round(estimate, 2), " (", floor(conf.low * 100) / 100, ", ", ceiling(conf.high * 100) / 100, ")"))

write.csv(estimates, file = "sens_hosp.csv")
```
